sentences.text: Shri Ranjan Banerjee, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Aseem Dixit, learned Govt. Advocate for the

. 
Heard on I.A.No.19046/2017 , which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.

The applicant has been tried and convicted for an offence under Sections 7 (1) read with Section 16 (1) (a) (ii) and 7 (1) 16 (1) (Ka) (ii) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and Section 7 (3), 7 (5)
read with Section 16 (1) (a) (ii), 7 (v) 16 (1) (Ka) (ii) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to suffer R.I. of 2 years and six months respectively and fine of Rs.1,000/- respectively,
with default stipulations.

Looking to the short period of sentence which is of two years, I am inclined to allow the application and suspend the remaining part of the jail sentence of the applicant - Rajesh Kumar and direct that he be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
The applicant is directed to appear before the Registry of this Court on 18.04.2018 and on such other dates as may be directed in this regard.

List this case in the week commencing 11.12.2017 for arguments on admission.
Cc as per rules.

(ATUL SREEDHARAN) JUDGE AM.
